evidenceState.OUT_OF_SAMPLE_EVALUATED: usefulness measured against later information, leakage-safe (produced by the Batch 3 B/C evaluator; no source holds it yet)
evidenceState.ADMISSION_GATE_MEASURED: a recorded admission-gate measurement exists; not a usefulness evaluation
evidenceState.CALIBRATION_FIT_MEASURED: value-curve shape fit measured (Hill holdout); not usefulness
evidenceState.DEPENDENCE_MEASURED: only dependence / agreement with other sources has been measured
evidenceState.UNEVALUATED: nothing about this source's usefulness or dependence is recorded

globalBlockers: NO_PREREGISTERED_LEAKAGE_SAFE_TARGET: target definition and evaluation are Batch 3 Units B/C (and the completed-trade benchmark is Unit I); until one is preregistered no source can be CLEANLY evaluated out of sample, whatever its archive holds
outOfSampleEvaluation.rule: per source: DATA_PREREQUISITES_MET needs a point-in-time archive of the source's OWN published values with >= 2 versions (git CSV history, export-archive snapshots or the temporal ledger); dependence/family overlap are caveats that force leave-family-out / leave-lineage-out designs, not blockers

weightingFormula: effective = base x freshness(age / expectedCadence) x health x coverage

lineageRelations.summary: Crowd (value) and Trades (vftValue) are two value modes of one KTC per-player payload. Separate B10 families by owner directive 2026-09-23; their mutual dependence is not measured in any recorded audit.
KTC Market is KTC's own published Crowd+Trades blend (ktc_market.KTC_MARKET_DERIVED_FROM); benchmark only, never a vote.

ktc (base) and ktcSfTep (TE++) are the historical Crowdsourced pair: calibration states of the same crowd opinion, retired into the ktcCrowd family. ktcSfTep carries the same TE++ crowd values as ktcCrowdSfTep.

Every Fantasy Navigator row carries a ktc_player_id and the site credits KeepTradeCut as a data source (recorded in the fetcher and registry). Placed in the ktcCrowd family so it can never be a hidden third KTC vote.

Raw Spearman 0.9395 vs ktcSfTep (2026-08-04). Normalized median deviation 0.156 vs KTC Crowd base SF, 0.166 vs Crowd TE++, 0.188 vs Trades TE++ on 431 shared players (2026-09-23). Curve SHAPE differs from KTC's: its held-out Hill RMSE is not flattered by KTC in training (ranking lineage is not curve lineage, H7).
Residual correlation +0.450 vs ktcSfTep (2026-08-04). PFK's fixed-holdout Hill RMSE is flattered 1.64x by KTC being in training (leave-lineage-out measurement, 2026-09-24).

PFK also publishes a pfk_ktc_values table that mirrors KTC (we deliberately read pfk_dynasty_rankings instead), so the provider holds KTC data; whether its own board is partly built from KTC is NOT established.
Residual correlation +0.677 (n=254, 2026-08-04). Both are crowd trade-value markets; common ancestry is NOT established and is not asserted.
Residual correlation +0.329 vs FantasyCalc (2026-08-04).

Residual correlation +0.891 vs base KTC on the 2026-07-27 instrument run (scripts/audit/measure_source_correlation.py): the strongest dependence in that matrix, cross-publisher and invisible to provider names. Not re-measured against the current Crowd/Trades inputs.
On the IDP-only IDP Show board: residual correlation +0.986 (n=188, 2026-08-04; raw Spearman 0.982-0.986) and +0.669 on the 2026-07-27 instrument run. Direction is not determinable from the repo.

The +0.986 dependence was measured on the IDP Show's IDP-only board, not on the combined board that votes today. Whether the IDP Trade Calculator licenses/derives its IDP board from The IDP Show (or vice versa) is NOT established, and the combined board's dependence on IDPTC has not been measured.
Offense: residual correlation +0.560 (n=255, 2026-08-04), +0.698 (2026-07-27); raw Spearman 0.9844 on 451 shared players; median value ratio 1.000 (p10 0.888, p90 1.054, 2026-07-26).
One provider, one login, one fetcher: SF rank, rookie SF, IDP, rookie IDP boards (the voting dlf family) plus the non-voting Trade Analyzer Values and pick values.
DLF Values ordering vs DLF Rank: Spearman 0.970 on 288 matched, 7.1% discordant pairs; values median 8.3% apart from DLF Rank's own rank->Hill value. Measured as NOT a duplicate.
Residual correlation -0.412 vs ktcSfTep (2026-08-04): among the most independent offense signals.
SF and IDP consensus boards plus Pat Fitzmaurice's trade value chart, all published by FantasyPros.

Fitzmaurice is a FantasyPros analyst and may be an input to the FantasyPros consensus; NOT established. Measured residuals are ANTI-correlated (-0.610 on 2026-08-04, -0.664 on 2026-07-27): one analyst departing from his employer's consensus.
Residual correlation +0.568 (2026-08-04), +0.681 (2026-07-27): cross-publisher.
Flock Fantasy's veteran superflex board and its rookie board. Mutual dependence not measured.
Offense and IDP slices of ONE draftsharks.com dynasty-rankings DOM, re-merged into one combined rank list (ds_combined_rank_partner).
Draft Sharks' rest-of-season boards: same provider, REDRAFT/ROS game type, so never a dynasty input.
Residual correlation -0.382 to -0.505 against every other source (2026-08-04): genuinely contrarian, which is also why the outlier filter drops it often.
Same publisher, two DIFFERENT quantities: the combined offense+IDP board (votes) and the IDP-only board (non-voting). The fetcher states the combined board is not a re-cut of the IDP board.
Signals says it aggregates unnamed community dynasty value markets and trade-implied values; treat as correlated with the KTC / FantasyCalc / Dynasty Daddy families until ancestry is disclosed.
